description:
Strings shown to the user that originate in packages must become codes plus params, localized at the UI edge:
- domain selection.ts: disabled reasons ("no key", "language unsupported", "needs Speechmatics audio", "Provided by <service>") and option labels/descriptions.
- domain identity.ts: match status/reasons, "Unknown", "Possibly <name>", anonymous "Speaker N" labels.
- SERVICE_NAMES and LANGUAGES display names (use Intl.DisplayNames for language names where possible).
- Errors surfaced via errorMessage(): introduce a typed user-facing error code for the ones the UI shows (key invalid, network, model download failed, quota, storage full); unknown errors fall back to a generic localized message plus the raw text in Diagnostics.
- pipeline export.ts: markdown header, default "Recording" title, date line; export follows the UI language.
Update existing tests (selection.test.ts etc.) to assert codes.
title: Domain and pipeline: return message codes instead of English sentences
